title: 3 VOLUMES OF 'ROBBERY UNDER AR...
reason: Remington 1888 three-volume first edition of Robbery Under Arms in original green cloth, catalogued only as '3 volumes'; a key Australian first edition, likely well over $500.
findings: Three volumes of Robbery Under Arms in original green publisher's cloth, front covers blocked in black with a flower and butterfly design, spines lettered in gilt 'Robbery Under Arms' with the author line (appears to read 'Bolderwood') and 'Vol. II' and 'Vol. III' legible. The vol. II title page (photos 2 and 3) reads 'Robbery Under Arms / A Story of Life and Adventure in the Bush and in the Goldfields of Australia / by Rolf Bolderwood / Three Volumes / Vol II / London / Remington and Co Publishers, Henrietta Street Covent Garden / 1888 [All Rights Reserved]', with a Remington advert (Memoirs of Prince Adam Czartoryski) on the facing page. That is the 1888 Remington three-volume first book edition, including the 'Bolderwood' misspelling and the green cloth blocked in black. The catalogue title does not say first edition. Only the vol. II title page was photographed, so half-titles, adverts and the state of vols. I and III were not checked. Reference: Sotheby's 'Library of an English Bibliophile III' (2013) lot 27 described the same Remington 1888 three-volume first book edition (Sadleir 261, Wolff 586) in original green cloth blocked in black, estimate GBP 1,500-2,000 for that lot (it included a second Boldrewood book); estimate only, no price realised shown; page seen 19/10/2026 at https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2013/library-english-bibliophile-l13411/lot.27.html
condition: Cloth rubbed with worn and frayed spine heads on all three volumes, bumped corners and edges, cloth colour still bright; page edges toned with foxing and spotting on the vol. II title page and margins; hinges and sewing not tested.
rescore_note: Vol II title page confirms the 1888 Remington three-volume first book edition in original green cloth blocked in black; a London dealer asks GBP 5,250 for a very good copy (abebooks.co.uk, seen 19/10/2026), so even this worn, foxed set (vols I and III title pages unseen) is likely well over $500; my estimate $800 to 2,000.
